changelog:
- Initial release of synapticchain skill.
- Provides autonomous on-chain Ed25519 identity attestation in under 40 seconds.
- Supports HTTP 402 micropayments for fast, low-cost API access.
- Enables high throughput with 256 parallel execution lanes.
- Includes features for gas sponsorship and an onboarding faucet for developers and agents.
summary: Autonomous On-Chain Ed25519 Identity Attestation, Gas Sponsorship, and HTTP 402 Micropayments across 256 Parallel Lanes on SynapticChain Layer-1.
